استأذنت (form X)

# اِسْتَأْذَنْتَ (istaʔḏanta) /is.taʔ.ðan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَأْذَنَ (istaʔḏana)
# اِسْتَأْذَنْتِ (istaʔḏanti) /is.taʔ.ðan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَأْذَنَ (istaʔḏana)
# اِسْتَأْذَنَتْ (istaʔḏanat) /is.t
